Class FileFilterBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.owasp.dependencycheck.utils.FileFilterBuilder
@NotThreadSafe public class FileFilterBuilder extends Object

Utility class for building useful FileFilter instances for AbstractFileTypeAnalyzer implementations. The built filter uses OrFileFilter to logically OR the given filter conditions. Example usage:

    FileFilter filter = FileFilterBuilder.newInstance().addExtensions("jar", "war").build();
Author:
Dale Visser
